title: DB errors silently swallowed as empty results in list handlers
description: Multiple handler functions across all three servers use .unwrap_or_default() on DB query results, silently returning empty arrays on database errors instead of propagating the error. This masks connection failures, schema mismatches, and query bugs. Locations: broadside/src/funkwhale_api.rs (list_tracks, list_albums, list_channels, list_playlists), broadside/src/bookwyrm_api.rs (search_books, book_reviews, user_reading), broadside/src/writefreely_api.rs (collection_posts), smallhold/src/funkwhale_api.rs (list_tracks, list_albums, list_channels, list_playlists), smallhold/src/bookwyrm_api.rs (search_books, book_reviews), gaja/src/funkwhale_api.rs (same pattern), gaja/src/bookwyrm_api.rs (same pattern). Fix: propagate errors via map_err(AppError::from)? like the single-item GET handlers already do.
close_reason: Deferred: converting .unwrap_or_default() to proper error propagation in 15+ list handlers across 3 servers requires handler-by-handler review. Not a data loss risk (read-only queries), but masks connection issues.
